newsitem.title: GREECE: GREEK PETZETAKIS SEES SALES GROWTH IN 97/98.
newsitem.headline: GREEK PETZETAKIS SEES SALES GROWTH IN 97/98.

text.p: Sales of Greek plastic pipe manufacturer Petzetakis are up 25 percent in the first five months of 1997, shareholders were told at the June 20 annual meeting.
Management also said turnover growth would remain high for the rest of 1997 and in 1998.
It based this forecast on a substantial rise in demand for rigid pipes used in sewerage, telecoms and natural gas projects in the Balkans and the Middle East.
The enrichment of the product mix with high-tech flexible pipes for industrial use which are chanelled into the EU market will also help sales.
The company said it had adopted a strategy to produce custom-designed integrated pipe systems.
Consolidated pretax earnings in 1996 reached 507 million drachmas on turnover of 24.3 billion versus 33.2 billion and 316 million respectively in 1995.

Petzetakis completed a 3.9 billion restructuring plan aimed at improving productivity and cutting down on costs, relocating its flexible pipes production facilities to Thebes from Piraeus. --Angelos Kiosklis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
